answer: Proposal: one identity per attested chip. A voting key must be generated inside a secure enclave whose signed quote chains to a manufacturer root; the ledger admits one active identity per device per epoch. Whether the work is classifying tundra imagery, relaying summit weather, or mapping grove fire risk, a second voice needs a second chip. Cap per-device epoch reward below the cheapest qualifying enclave's per-epoch cost, rented or amortized, so cloning loses money. Assumes honest manufacturer roots and unbroken enclaves; limit: side-channel breaks.
